name: ACA 331 烟雾 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 331, from Wuhan to Vancouver, push back and start up have been completed, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 331，从 Wuhan 到 Vancouver，推出和开车已完成，准备滑行，联系武汉地面请求滑行指令。

cards.audioText: ACA 331, taxi to holding point Runway 18R via taxiway A7, A, Z4 and C.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 331，经 A7、A、Z4 和 C 滑行道滑行至 Runway 18R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 18R via taxiway A seven, A, Z four and C, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 A7、A、Z4 和 C 滑行道滑行至 Runway 18R 等待点，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: ACA 331, follow Airbus 319 on M to holding point Runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 331，跟随 M 上的 Airbus 319 前往 Runway 18R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: follow Airbus 319 on M to holding point Runway 18R, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随 M 上的 Airbus 319 前往 Runway 18R 等待点，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: ACA 331, Runway 18R is closed due to disabled aircraft on the runway, change your ATC clearance to Runway 18L, ZF-12 departure, the rest unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 331，因 Runway 18R 上有故障航空器，该跑道已关闭，将你的 ATC 放行许可更改为 Runway 18L、ZF-12 离场，其余不变。
cards.referenceText: roger, Runway 18L, ZF-12 departure, the rest unchanged, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，Runway 18L，ZF-12 离场，其余不变，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: ACA 331, enter Runway 18R from C3, vacate runway via C4, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 331，从 C3 进入 Runway 18R，经 C4 脱离跑道，脱离后报告。
cards.referenceText: enter Runway 18R from C tree, vacate runway via C four, report vacated, 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从 C3 进入 Runway 18R，经 C4 脱离跑道，脱离后报告，331。

cards.audioText: now you have exited the Runway 18R via C4, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已从 C4 脱离 Runway 18R，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 331, Runway 18R vacated via C4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 331，已从 C4 脱离 Runway 18R。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, continue taxi to holding point 18 left via taxiway M, A and A1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，继续经滑行道 M、A 和 A1 滑行至 18L 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi to holding point 18L via taxiway M, A and A1, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续经滑行道 M、A 和 A1 滑行至 18L 等待点，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: now you are airborne, climbing to 1,800 meters, you see a helicopter 10 o' clock above, it is closing to your aircraft, inform Wuhan Departure and request right turn to avoid the traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，正爬升至 1,800 米，看到一架直升机位于 10 点钟上方，正在接近你的航空器，通知武汉离场并请求右转避让。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA 331, airborne, climbing to 1,800 meters, we see helicopter 10 o' clock above, closing, request right turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，ACA 331，已离地，正爬升至 1,800 米，我们看到一架直升机位于 10 点钟上方，正在接近，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText: ACA 331, turn right heading 240, expedite climb to 2,400 meters, maintain visual separation with the helicopter.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 331，右转航向 240，加速爬升至 2,400 米，与直升机保持目视间隔。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 240, expedite climb to 2,400 meters, maintain visual separation, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，加速爬升至 2,400 米，保持目视间隔，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, after traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb and maintain 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，交通解除后，直飞 ZF，恢复自主导航，爬升并保持 5100 米。
cards.referenceText: After traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb and maintain 5100 meters, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 交通解除后，直飞 ZF，恢复自主导航，爬升并保持 5100 米，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9500 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 5655, contact Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你保持 9500 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 5655，联系郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA 331, maintaining 9500 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 5655.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA 331，保持 9500 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 5655。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, climb and maintain 10100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，郑州管制，雷达识别，爬升并保持 10100 米。

cards.audioText: suddenly your cabin crew reports there are toxic fumes in rear cabin, you decided to expedite descent for smoke removal. make a distress call to Zhengzhou Control and request to level off at 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱机组突然报告后舱有有毒烟雾，你决定加速下降以排烟。向郑州管制发出遇险呼叫，并请求在 3000 米改平。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Zhengzhou Control, ACA 331, our cabin crew reports there are toxic fumes in rear cabin, request expedite descent for smoke removal, request level off at 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，郑州管制，ACA 331，客舱机组报告后舱有有毒烟雾，请求加速下降以排烟，请求在 3000 米改平。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 030, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1008, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，收到 MAYDAY，右转航向 030，按 QNH 1008 下降到 3000 米，可以时报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 030, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1008, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 030，按 QNH 1008 下降到 3000 米，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: B: After cabin check, tell Zhengzhou Control the toxic fume might be caused by dangerous goods leaking in the cargo hold.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 客舱检查后，告诉郑州管制，有毒烟雾可能由货舱危险品泄漏引起。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA 331, the toxic fume might be caused by dangerous goods leaking in the cargo hold.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA 331，有毒烟雾可能由货舱危险品泄漏引起。

cards.audioText: B: Several passengers have been seriously affected by the toxic fume and become unconscious, tell Zhengzhou Control the situation and request diversion to Zhengzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 数名旅客受到有毒烟雾严重影响并失去意识，向郑州管制说明情况并请求改航 Zhengzhou。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA 331, several passengers have been seriously affected by the toxic fume and become unconscious, request divert to Zhengzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA 331，数名旅客受到有毒烟雾严重影响并失去意识，请求改航 Zhengzhou。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, Zhengzhou Control, roger, turn left heading 360, contact Zhengzhou Approach 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，郑州管制，收到，左转航向 360，联系郑州进近120.35。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, Zhengzhou Approach, radar contact, track direct to CGO, descend to 3000 meters, expect radar vector ILS Runway 12.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，郑州进近，雷达识别，直飞 CGO，下降到 3000 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 12。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to CGO, descend to 3000 meters, expect radar vector ILS Runway 12, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 CGO，下降到 3000 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 12，ACA 331。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 331, what assistance do you need?
B: tell Zhengzhou Approach you need ambulance and dangerous goods specialists.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：ACA 331，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉郑州进近，你需要救护车和危险品专家。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Approach, ACA 331, request ambulance and dangerous goods specialists.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州进近，ACA 331，请求救护车和危险品专家。
